text:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync request — vendors flagged late firmware/driver issues for H100 and MI300 that could affect SKU gating and marketplace images. Need to decide lab priority + fallback routing for the next 72h. TL;DR: MI300 driver packaged for RH kernel 6.5 is flaky, H100 PM patch rolling, Gaudi looks green.

alex-eng-infra: Thanks — can you paste vendor notes? also which SKUs are at risk?

maria-partnerships: pasted: 
- MI300: driver v2.1.4 fails CUDA-compatible runtime on RH 6.5 when MIG enabled. Vendor suggests workaround = disable MIG or use temp kernel 5.19 image.
- H100: power management firmware v1.8 reduces perf on sustained 4k token streams; patch v1.9 rolling to partners.
- Gaudi: no issues reported.

ben-ops: From capacity side, we have two lab slots next 48h (staging-1, staging-3). Recommend dedicating staging-1 to MI300 smoke tests with kernel 5.19 image and staging-3 to H100 perf regression.

raj-sre: If MI300 needs kernel downgrade we'll need an image variant in marketplace and a routing rule to fall back to an alternate region for affected customers. Can we avoid a public rollback?

emily-platform: We can create a temporary image tag: `redwood/mi300:kernel-5.19-temp` and set a route rule for `model.variant=mi300-kernel-5.19-temp` with a 10% canary first. That avoids global rollback.

maria-partnerships: @emily-platform love it. Ben — can you reserve staging-1 for the MI300 run and schedule the canary? Raj — any ops checklist items we should attach to the runbook?

ben-ops: Reserving staging-1 now. Will add canary job in CI to spin up 20 containers against the temp image, run perf+smoke, and push metrics to console. ETA for results: ~18h.

raj-sre: Checklist: (1) alerting on 5xx/timeout spike, (2) token-cost deviation alert, (3) KV cache hit-rate drop monitor. I'll add abort-on-error policy to the canary job.

maria-partnerships: Perfect. Also cc'ing vendor liaisons — if tests fail we need a prioritized escalation lane so they patch faster. I'll send a quick note to vendor reps with the test window.

emily-platform: Small note — H100 perf patch v1.9 expected to be staged tomorrow AM. If validated, we can avoid an H100 rollback; plan is to A/B it in staging-3 with 5% traffic.

alex-eng-infra: If MI300 canary fails, what's our fallback for customers pinned to MI300? route to H100/B200? we should document expected latency/cost delta.

maria-partnerships: Good point. Fallback order proposal: (1) same-region H100 (if capacity exists), (2) B200 in region, (3) cross-region MI300 healthy pool. I'll draft the cost/latency delta in the runbook.

ben-ops: Adding fallback playbook to the canary job. Will include traffic-switchover script and manual approvals.

raj-sre: I'll prepare a short postmortem template in case the incident spans >4h. Keeps communications clear for partners.

deploy-bot: Deployed canary job config to `ci/canaries/mi300-kernel-5.19-temp.yml` by ben-ops at 1717005980.

maria-partnerships: Thanks team — I'll ping vendor contacts, reserve an urgent partner call if tests fail. Will update this thread with vendor response and the canary link. :thumbsup:

emily-platform: Echoing — I put a console dashboard link in #eng-platform (embed) for real-time metrics.

maria-partnerships: Final ask: if partner patch ETA slips beyond 48h we run the fallback plan + customer comms template. I'll prepare the comms draft and share here.

alex-eng-infra: A couple followups — please add exact SKU IDs and sample customer profiles to the runbook so support can triage quickly.

maria-partnerships: Will do. Closing loop: staging slots reserved, canary job live, vendor notified. Updates in ~18h or sooner.
